# outlines

Generate full YouTube video outlines in your format — hook, structured body with talking points, visual aid callouts, source citations, time budgets, and production notes. Trigger on phrases like 'outline this video', 'write an outline for', 'structure this video', 'create a video outline', 'help me outline', or any request to plan or structure a YouTube video for recording.
